Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0406281 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :

We see an error in the Credit card terminal timeout error: “
Error status credit card terminal : terminal communication timeout”. We see this appearing since 1st Feb on AWS.
We request you to please check the wiring of the credit card terminal. Attached image 1 showcases the wiring.
If the wiring is found ok, please also carry a spare part of the terminal. The attached image 2 is the spare part.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
